title: SuccessfulMatch.com notifies SeniorMatch users of unauthorized access to account information
date_note: The day the notice was reported to the California Attorney General (the register's Reported Date, 11/18/2026); the sample notice is undated ('[Notification Date]'). The notice says unauthorized access ran from October 18 to October 20, 2026.
place: United States (headquarters not stated in the notice)
geo_basis: country only: filed with the California Attorney General; the notice gives no address
summary: SuccessfulMatch.com filed a breach notice with California's Attorney General. The notice, written to SeniorMatch users, says that on October 20, 2026 the company discovered unauthorized access to certain user information between October 18 and October 20. Usernames, email addresses and profile information may be involved; the company says it has not determined whether data or photos were downloaded and is still investigating whether payment-related information was involved.
plain: SeniorMatch says someone got into some user account details in October 2026, possibly usernames, email addresses and profiles. It does not yet know if anything was downloaded.
exec: User account information accessed; the company asks users to watch for suspicious emails and messages.
action: SeniorMatch's notice asks users to remain alert to suspicious emails, messages or requests for personal information.
impact: Number of users affected not stated in the notice or the register entry.

sources.name: California Attorney General: SuccessfulMatch.com, Inc. breach notification
SeniorMatch sample notice (filed with the California AG)

report.publisher: SuccessfulMatch.com, Inc. (filed with the California Attorney General)
key_findings: On October 20, 2026, the company discovered unauthorized access to certain SeniorMatch user information between October 18 and October 20, 2026.
Usernames, email addresses and profile information may have been involved; it has not determined whether any information or photos were downloaded.
It secured the affected system, disabled the compromised account and addressed the identified security issue.
recommendations: Remain alert to suspicious emails, messages, or requests for personal information.

evidence.quote: On October 20, 2026, we discovered unauthorized access to certain SeniorMatch user information between October 18 and October 20, 2026.

validation.note: Primary: the company's sample notice, filed with and published by the California Attorney General (register entry sb24-633062 under SuccessfulMatch.com, Inc., breach date 10/18/2026, reported 11/18/2026); the notice itself is written as SeniorMatch. No other publisher read.
